definition: Automation or equivalent technology makes labor earnings cease to be the main effective distribution channel for the scoped population. Continuing useful activity does not imply a zero variant.
zero_variant_rule: The technology-driven post-wage transition has not occurred, is deliberately restrained, or remains an uncertain earnings-based best guess. No threshold of nonworking determines this flag.

regimes.label: Distributed or personal assets without guarantees

c.basis: Shared or freely accessible technological provision, rather than current earnings, is the central distribution model.

s.basis: Technological support is allocated through membership, status or institutional authority rather than primarily purchased with current wages.

r.basis: Access to productive assets or accumulated capital is the central claim on technological output; this need not provide a universal floor.

a.basis: An independent technical system sustains or allocates the material environment; current wages are not its primary access rule.

x.basis: Automation has substantially displaced the wage channel for the selected population without establishing a secure replacement; this is a dystopian post-wage interpretation.

m.basis: A partial technological transition plausibly makes nonwage access central for this scoped population, while important work and market dependencies remain.

w.basis: The selected economy still primarily links material access to earnings and commercial purchases despite labor-saving technology.

l.basis: Continued service or productive work remains the main condition of earning access or maintenance; supporting a workforce alone does not establish a post-wage economy.

t.basis: Relevant automation is restrained, unavailable or deliberately limited, so the selected population has not made the technology-driven post-wage transition.

h.basis: Essential labor by actual persons remains central without sufficient technological substitution; communal sharing, biological origin or robot embodiment alone does not establish the transition.

u.basis: The saved account does not establish a central nonwage material channel; the retained best guess is a continuing earnings-based technical economy, with low confidence.

confidence: All new allocation judgments are low-confidence editorial best guesses from existing scoped evidence, not production-share measurements.
legacy_fields: legacy_classification records historical numbers, not current taxonomy; immutable historical batches retain their original numbering.
